map.水准路线高差与高程计算，支持闭合差与容许闭合差检核: Leveling-route height difference and elevation computation, with misclosure and allowable-misclosure checking
map.终点已知高程 Hn (m，闭合水准填): Known end elevation Hn (m, for closed leveling)
map.高差 h = a − b（后视减前视）；高程逐站累加。闭合差 fh = 实测终点: Height diff h = a − b (backsight minus foresight); elevation accumulates station by station. Misclosure fh = measured end elevation − known elevation; allowable misclosure = ±coefficient×√(ΣL) mm. Ordinary leveling often uses coefficient ±40.
map.附合/闭合水准算高差与闭合差。: Compute and check height difference and misclosure for open/closed leveling.
map.按每公里限差判合格。: Judge acceptance by the per-km limit.
map.闭合水准实测 Σh=+0.012m，理论应为 0 → f_h=+12mm；限差=: Closed leveling measured Σh = +0.012 m, theory should be 0 → f_h = +12 mm; limit = ±12√L (mm, L in km), at L = 1 km the tolerance is ±12 mm, just acceptable.
map.闭合差按测站数反号分配，每站改正 −12/n mm，得各点高程。: Distribute the misclosure by station count with reversed sign; each station gets a correction −12/n mm to obtain each point's elevation.
map.等外 ±12√L mm、四等 ±20√L mm（L km），等级越高越严。: Below-standard ±12√L mm, fourth-order ±20√L mm (L in km); higher order is stricter.
map.先查仪器i角/读数，超限重测，不可硬平分掩盖粗差。: First check the instrument i-angle / readings; remeasure if over limit, never force a split to hide gross errors.
